layout.padding: manual left padding; tokenizer remains right
layout.target: canonical leading space; add_special_tokens=False; remove leading BOS/UNK

definitions.nl rewrite/rephrase/neighborhood acc: teacher-forced desired target token accuracy; not NLL preference and not free generation
definitions.tf_token_micro: sum(correct desired target tokens)/sum(valid desired target tokens)
definitions.tf_prompt_macro: mean per prompt(correct desired target tokens/valid desired target tokens)
definitions.tf_strict: all desired target tokens predicted correctly, then prompt average
definitions.R_plus_twoP_joint: per request conjunction of rewrite and exactly two canonical paraphrases, separately TF strict and NLL preference
definitions.NLL: mean negative log probability across all valid target tokens per prompt; report new/true/desired prompt macro
definitions.desired_margin: RS/PS true NLL minus new NLL; NS new NLL minus true NLL; positive desired preference
definitions.alias_policy: NLL-preference accuracy labels are aliases of RS/PS/NS; never independent accuracy evidence

denominators.failure: failed edits remain in evaluation denominator
denominators.case_order: unchanged fixed10k; paired identities include prompt/targets and target token identity
denominators.missing: null with explicit denominator; never fabricated
denominators.B1: each of exactly two independent cold jobs observes its own entry/WN/selected endpoints after seal; expected current R100/P200/N1000, actual canonical inventory is authoritative; exact same-input FP32 endpoint aliases may reuse observations only within that job
denominators.neighborhood_retention: W0-correct preference prompts, W0-strict prompts, W0-correct token positions each have separate denominators
denominators.B1_B100: each arm processes fixed records[:10000] as 100 successive batches; current, first100, fixedhash panel each batch, full latest-valid RS/PS and cumulative NS only at sealed observation batches; no B300 or prefix-sharing continuation

statistics.bootstrap_unit: request cluster, including all prompts and tokens
statistics.interval: paired percentile 95%; recompute ratios of cluster sums

raw_git_policy: only compact identities, scalar values and correctness flags; no prompt text/logits/tensors

observation_schedule.full_latest_valid: one latest occurrence per active fact-version; RS/PS
observation_schedule.cumulative_neighborhood: all encountered occurrences including same-target repeats, superseded and failed edits; NS
observation_schedule.first100: fixed first100 occurrence IDs, even when superseded

panel.eligible: active past versions excluding current facts

observation_schedule.union: fixed dataset order, each case evaluated once per distinct endpoint

endpoint_comparisons.timing: all official observations only after selection seal
endpoint_comparisons.baseline: cold W0 measured on missing cases only after selection seal
endpoint_comparisons.occurrence_atwrite: each case own final write, including failed edits
endpoint_comparisons.version_teacher: original at-write full-vocab replay asset remains immutable; not reset by observer

bank: selected objective bank before current commit
strata.age: postwrite batch-created_batch, bins 0/1-5/6-10/11-20/21-50/51+; distinct from replay age t-1-created_batch
strata.coverage: only observed union; superseded complete at full cumulative-N observations

bootstrap.unit: request cluster, all prompts and tokens together
bootstrap.timing: terminal CPU analysis, not per-batch GPU observers

limitations: TF accuracy is not free generation
independent cold arms; no cross-job W/M/teacher reuse
same aggregate scores do not imply same lost/gained identities
no N4 or R-only lifelong superiority established by these two arms
RES versus GSS_REC jointly changes history selection and recency weighting; their individual causal contributions cannot be separated by this two-arm comparison

storage.raw: local compact identity/scalar JSON or gzip; no prompt/model/logit arrays

scope_supersession.prior_four_endpoint_B300_contract: source/evaluator definitions reused read-only; horizon and endpoint count superseded
scope_supersession.prior_three_arm_shared_prefix: superseded; two independent cold jobs, planned 200 native/reference batch states
